summary: Announces a mail server at UCSB listening on socket 3 that implements the small part of FTP needed to deliver mail: the MAIL and BYE commands. It lists the UCSB users who could receive network mail and their user names.

eli5.summary: A university computer opened a mailbox for the network. You could send letters to a short list of people there, and this note names them.

questions: how did early ftp mail delivery work
